text:
"The fifth set has nothing to do with tennis" + "If you hit the best shot in the world at the wrong moment, it's the wrong shot."

Agassi on out-of-body experiences/flow state, emotion, overthinking, instinct, and shot selection

--

1. "I've heard old-timers say that the fifth set has nothing to do with tennis. It's true. The fifth set is about emotion and conditioning. Slowly I leave my body. Nice knowing you, body. I've had several out-of-body experiences over my career, but this one is healthy. I trust my skill, and I step out of its way. I remove myself from the equation."

2. "You need to retrain that muscle with which a tennis player decides in the heat of battle that this shot is the right one and that shot is the wrong one. You need to remember that it doesn't matter if you hit the best shot in the world--remember? If it's the wrong moment, it's the wrong shot."

"Every shot is is an educated guess, and I'm no longer educated. I'm as green as I was in juniors. It took me twenty-two years to discover my talent, to win my first slam--and only two years to lose it." 🔥🔥🔥
